title: onboard-hestia-7b-v1.1-performance-metadata-and-changelog-automation
author: Asha Patel
description: Onboard Hestia-7b v1.1 with curated metadata, validated performance profiles, and integration into the changelog automation pipeline. Motivation: customers requested a stable 7B variant with tuned perf profiles for low-latency inference and predictable cost; this PR adds the metadata manifest, per-hardware perf profiles, unit tests, and a hook to generate a release changelog entry automatically on merge. Checklist: add model metadata YAML; add perf_profiles JSON for A10G/A100/CPU; add CI job to validate perf profile schema; add changelog generation hook and template; add docs page and quickstart snippet; unit and perf tests added and passing. Linked items: ENG-1327 (model onboarding), PM-481 (product launch coordination).
